legacy_client_safety.evidence: Existing fields can remain accepted if pos is additive.

conflict_detection.evidence: Phase 1 introduced pos_conflict for read tools. Mutation tools need the same behavior.

service_layer_risk.evidence: The change can stay in the tools layer without changing orchestration service contracts.

findings.summary: pos must be additive; legacy mutation fields must remain supported.
If pos and legacy fields disagree, handlers must reject the call.
